description: Answers: can I trust this map card for today? Use it when a person asks about a place (route to a castle, a museum, a shop, a cafe) and you have its card from Google Maps or another map service. Pass what the card showed: name (required), optional lat and lon, rating and reviews (number of ratings), date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today in Germany), state (German state code, default HH), hours (up to 6 items {source, open, close} or {source, closed:true} for the date), review_dates (up to 60 ISO dates), category, crowd_text (e.g. the 'usually not busy' line). Returns: public holiday, Sunday or holiday eve in the state; the rating weighed by how many ratings stand behind it; whether the sources agree on the hours; how old the reviews are; which fields you did not give; pointers to DWD, flood and road tools and to check_claim for description claims like 'only' or 'oldest'. Holidays come from fixed rules, the rest only from what you pass; Orb Studio reads, copies and stores no Google Maps content and is not affiliated with Google (Google Maps is a trademark of Google LLC). Not a recommendation to go or not to go, no rating of the place; for pharmacies, doctors and banks only a note and the official source. Free, no AI, no web search.

name.description: Place name as shown on the card

reviews.description: Number of ratings behind the average

state.description: German state code (HH, BY, NW...) or name; default HH
